title: Pedagogical Practices
learningGoal: Help parents understand how children learn and how to support learning at home.
microLesson: Pedagogy refers to how children learn through play, exploration, repetition, and relationships. Parents support learning by offering hands-on experiences, asking open-ended questions, and encouraging curiosity.
activity: Engage your child in a learning activity (e.g., building, sorting, exploring). Reflect on what they learned.
